title: General Manager Automobile Service
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced and results\-driven **General Manager (GM)** to lead the overall operations of our Automotive Service Center. The GM will be responsible for profitability, customer satisfaction, team leadership, compliance, and operational excellence across all departments including workshop, spare parts, body shop, and front office.

**\+Key Responsibilities**

**\- Business \& Financial Performance**

* Drive revenue growth, cost control, and overall profitability
* Prepare and monitor monthly budgets, MIS reports, and KPIs
* Achieve targets for service revenue, parts sales, labor utilization, and margins
* Analyze financial statements and implement corrective actions

**\- Operations Management**

* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of workshop, parts, and body shop
* Ensure optimal capacity utilization and productivity
* Implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and OEM guidelines
* Monitor turnaround time (TAT) and job completion quality

**\- Team Leadership \& HR**

* Lead, mentor, and develop department managers and staff
* Ensure discipline, performance management, and training
* Conduct regular performance reviews and team meetings
* Build a high\-performance, customer\-focused culture

**\- Customer Experience**

* Ensure high customer satisfaction and retention
* Resolve escalated customer complaints effectively
* Monitor CSI/NPS scores and implement improvements
* Maintain strong relationships with key customers and fleet clients

**\- Spare Parts \& Inventory Control**

* Ensure availability of fast\-moving parts
* Optimize inventory levels and reduce obsolescence
* Monitor parts revenue, stock turns, and shrinkage

**\- Quality \& Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to safety standards and statutory regulations
* Maintain OEM audit readiness and quality benchmarks
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives

**\- Business Development**

* Develop strategies to attract new customers and retain existing ones
* Build partnerships with insurance companies, corporates, and fleet operators
* Identify new revenue streams (AMC, quick service, accessories, etc.)

**Ideal Candidate:** A strategic leader who can run the service center like a profit\-driven business unit while delivering exceptional customer experience.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Automotive service: 10 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

4\. Enhance contactability of the customers by collecting contact details.  

  

5\. Participate in cost savings initiatives.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist II
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist II
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Job responsibilities**  

* In conjunction with all of Talent Acquisition, creates a deep and diverse talent pool to service resourcing requirements across multiple business units.
* Collaborates directly with hiring managers to understand business and skill set requirements to build a comprehensive strategic hiring plan by setting the vision, strategy, and goals to ensure current and future resource demands are met.
* As a strategic partner to your hiring managers, provide expertise in market insights, talent landscape, and an understanding of talent needs to establish expectations and build a collaborative approach with your customers to meet demands.
* Ensure customer satisfaction by providing regular updates to hiring managers and setting expectations on the hiring process per requisition or department, or both, as required.
* Utilize appropriate sourcing channels (including applicant tracking system, candidate relationship management system, job boards, advertising, networking, employee referral program) to identify qualified candidates.
* Monitor recruitment sourcing methods and provide recommendations to improve applicant attraction. Suggests innovative solutions to sourcing challenges and competitive intelligence from those efforts.
* Offers creative solutions to sourcing hard to fill requisitions in collaboration with the business.
* Responsible to manage full cycle recruiting process to include but not limited to: complete initial screening interview of potential candidates and reject non\-relevant applications, prepare candidate profile for hiring manager following interview screen, submit short listed candidates to hiring managers for review, conducts candidate debrief session after interviews are completed and extends verbal offers of employment to successful candidates.
* Ensures data accuracy within Applicant Tracking System.
* Initiates and maintains open communication with hiring managers and Human Resources (HR) colleagues in meeting recruiting needs.
* May create collateral HR materials for trade shows, professional organization meetings, and career fairs. May attend trade shows, professional organization meetings and career fairs.
* May provide training and coaching activities for Talent Acquisition Specialists.
* Performs other job\-related duties as assigned
**Qualifications \- External**

**What we’re looking for**  

Basic Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
* Experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter in a corporate or agency environment
* Proven track record in direct sourcing and managing an end\-to\-end recruiting process required
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to think and influence strategically
* Proven track record in utilizing creative recruitment techniques and measurement of results
* Ability to work well with multi\-functional team and with all levels within organization
* Strong problem solving, influencing, negotiating, facilitating and partnership skills required
* Ability to effectively engage and build relationships with line management, employees, and HR team at all levels
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively manage multiple demands without missing deadlines
* Strong time management skills and able to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong customer services skills
* Strong attention to detail and an ability to maintain confidentiality
Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience as a full cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter supporting a CRO or in the Pharmaceutical industry
* Experience working in Workday
* Experience with a CRM
**Get to know Syneos Health**

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.  

  



http://www.syneoshealth.com


**Additional Information**

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

title: AI / ML Internship at Hyderabad
description:
Development Department
Hyderabad • India •
**Overview**
------------


This is a hands\-on, project\-driven internship where you will work directly alongside our ML/AI Engineers and AI Agent Engineers. You will contribute to real deliverables, not just observe, spanning computer vision, multimodal learning, agentic systems, and RAG pipelines.The track you work on is flexible and will be matched to your interests, background, and the team's current priorities. We believe great interns come from many different starting points, curiosity, logical thinking, and a willingness to learn matter more than a perfect resume.By the end of 6 months, you will have worked on production\-adjacent AI systems and built a portfolio of meaningful, demonstrable work


**Skills**
----------

  

  

**Basic Technical Skills (Good to Have, Not All Required)**

* Python basics — ability to write scripts, run notebooks, and understand existing code.
* Familiarity with any ML/DL concept — even from coursework or self\-study counts.
* Exposure to tools like Jupyter, Google Colab, HuggingFace, or OpenAI API.
* Basic understanding of NLP, computer vision, or LLMs — at any depth.
* Comfortable using Git for version control.

**What You Will Work On**


Depending on your track, your day\-to\-day work may include contributions across any of the following areas:

**Vision Track**

* Assist with dataset collection, labeling, and augmentation
* Run and evaluate pre\-trained models (YOLO, ResNet, SAM, CLIP)
* Support model fine\-tuning and performance benchmarking
* Document experiments and results clearly

**Agents Track**

* Write, test, and refine prompts for agent workflows
* Help build and test tool\-calling integrations
* Research and benchmark agent frameworks and orchestrators
* Assist in deploying agents to GPT Store or Copilot Studio

**Multimodal (MLM) Track**

* Explore and test vision\-language models


(LLaVA, BLIP\-2\)

* Prepare multimodal datasets and evaluation sets
* Run inference pipelines and document outputs

**RAG \& Knowledge Track**

* Support document ingestion, chunking, and embedding pipelines
* Test retrieval quality across different vector stores
* Experiment with chunking strategies and re\-ranking methods
* Compare model performance across tasks (VQA, captioning)
* Help evaluate RAG pipeline accuracy and relevance

**Cross\-Track Responsibilities**


Regardless of track, all interns will contribute to:

* Research \& Benchmarking — survey latest models, tools, and papers summarize findings for the team.
* Prompt Writing \& Testing — write, iterate, and evaluate prompts across different LLMs and tasks.
* Model Evaluation \& Testing — run structured evaluations, log results, and identify failure patterns.
* Data Work — collection, cleaning, annotation, and quality checks as needed by the team.
* Documentation — write clear technical notes, how\-to guides, and experiment logs.
* Team Collaboration — participate in standups, sprint planning, and design reviews.

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Education**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Electronics, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Final\-year students and fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

 **What Matters Most**

* Curiosity — genuine interest in AI and willingness to go deep on problems.
* Logical thinking — ability to break down a problem and think through it step by step.
* Communication — can clearly explain what you tried, what worked, and what did not.
* Initiative — proactively looks for ways to contribute rather than waiting to be told.
* Coachability — open to feedback and fast to apply it.

 **What You Will Gain**

* Real\-world experience building and shipping AI systems — not just toy projects.
* Mentorship from ML/AI Engineers actively working on vision, agents, and multimodal systems.
* A strong portfolio of demonstrable work to show in future job applications.
* Exposure to the full AI product lifecycle — from idea to deployment.
* Certificate of completion and a performance\-based letter of recommendation.
* Potential for a full\-time offer based on performance during the internship.

### **How to Apply**

* Send your resume to: **careers@smartinfologiks.com**
* For queries, call: **\+91\-8080727912**

title: Data Analysis
description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
* Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counselling employees and supervisors.
* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

title: FP&A Lead – Expenses
description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.


Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.


That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.


Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.


For our business, for clients, and for you

**About the Company**


Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003 is one of the world’s largest financial service providers with c.13,000 employees operating out of c.85 offices in 42 countries. The Group has c.$3 trillion assets under management and has delivered strong growth of \>10% year on year for the last 3 years. Apex Group offers a single source solution to customers for financial services as it has the broadest range of services amongst its competitors. These services include fund administration solutions, digital on\-boarding of bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, corporate and family office services, business services including HR and payroll and a pioneering ESG ratings and advisory service for private companies.

**Pune Global Service Centre FP\&A Team**


India is growing as an Apex Group finance hub as it provides intelligent, enthusiastic, and energetic professionals to compliment a strong global finance team. This is a great opportunity to join the Global FP\&A Team who have chosen Pune as their FP\&A Global Service Centre (GSC).


The FP\&A Pune Team started with a 7\-member team in 2021 in Phase 1\. Following early successes of the Pune team and the need for increased reporting to stakeholders following a high number of recent business acquisitions, the team grew to 32 members by 2024 in the subsequent hiring phases. We now have a team of technically strong and energetic employees and middle management professionals delivering an increasing number of data sets, standardized deliverables, and improved analytical reporting to assist the Global FP\&A team in managing reporting for the entire portfolio of Group Companies.


The FP\&A organizational structure is relatively flat thereby increasing opportunities for everyone to grow and build a successful career.


We are looking to hire team members who will complement our world class high performing team. These roles are expected to drive data cleansing, standardized processing and be engaging with business, management, and finance teams across the globe.

**The Role**

This is an exciting opportunity for a Finance professional to join a high performing Global FP\&A team operating in a fast growth Global Financial Services organization.


We have a few openings at Associate, Senior Associate and Assistant Vice President levels.


The Global FP\&A team is functionally structured with Group Reporting (which includes synergy reporting as well), Revenue, People Cost and Other Expense Reporting and Partnering as the main pillars who also play a major role in stake holder partnership and management. The Entire Team and each Pillar is led by extremely knowledgeable, experienced, dedicated, and professional leaders.


Basis the specific function the activities may differ, but an overall list of activities covered under the various roles are as below:

* Close partnership with the FP\&A Regional Finance, Business Leads and Cost Centre Owners
* Understand the main drivers while performing various activities under the different pillars (functions) of the Global FP\&A Team to help perform better
* Perform and own day to day, monthly BAU activities and ad hoc requests
* Perform the Forecast and Planning activities
	+ Actual vs Plan
	+ Role Relocation / Target Operating Model Tracking
	+ Synergy Tracking
* Do a Deep dive analysis of the P\&L with detailed commentary for various Stakeholders
	+ The Leadership team (Global FP\&A)
	+ Group Segment / Product Leads and Group Regional Heads
	+ Group CFO
	+ Group COO
* Assist the seniors in preparing various reports and dash boards (e.g: Reports related to Profitability, revenue growth, trend analytics etc)
* Help in improvisation and enhancement of existing “Workday / Adaptive” system
* Work within the team to create a robust team culture with proper back up for processes, SOP \& documentation
* Work towards automation (basis requirement), system transformation, innovation projects, enhancing the processes for better control and analytics
* For Leadership roles, the leads will need to drive, own and work towards creating a robust structure functionally and administratively

**Skills Required:**

* Minimum of 7\-15 years Financial Planning \& Analysis experience (Depending on the position)
* Proficiency in Microsoft package (Word/Excel/Power Point). Power BI Knowledge is an added advantage
* Knowledge of Workday/Adaptive Planning (Group Management Reporting system) preferred
* Project Management Skills, Self\-starter, Ability to multitask, good team player
* Take accountability and end to end ownership of the tasks managed
* Decision making capability and Attention to detail
* Customer Centricity (Stakeholder Centricity)
* Good Communication \& Stakeholder Management skills
* Strong Time Management skill, ability to work under pressure
* Demonstrable use and management of large data sets
* Data analytics and visualization skills
* Knowledge of Prophix (group management reporting system) and Financial Force an added advantage

**What you will get in return:**

* A high level of visibility within a large organization which is on an upward trajectory
* Be part of a dynamic and fast\-paced team that makes a visible contribution to Management decision making and deliver a tangible impact on the business.
* Exposure to all aspects of the business, cross\-jurisdiction and to working with a broad range of internal stakeholders.
* Opportunity to work with a diverse, agile and global finance and management teams.

**Additional information:**


We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio\-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made based on skills, qualifications and experience.


We measure our success as a business, not only by delivering great products and services and continually increasing our assets under administration and market share, but also by how we positively impact people, society, and the planet.


For more information on our commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) please visit https://theapexgroup.com/csr\-policy/

Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

title: Senior HRIS Specialist Core HCM
description:
**Location(s): Pune, Berlin, London, Warsaw**

**About Springer Nature Group**

Springer Nature opens the doors to discovery for researchers, educators, clinicians and other professionals. Every day, around the globe, our imprints, books, journals, platforms and technology solutions reach millions of people. For over 184 years our brands and imprints have been a trusted source of knowledge to these communities and today, more than ever, we see it as our responsibility to ensure that fundamental knowledge can be found, verified, understood and used by our communities – enabling them to improve outcomes, make progress, and benefit the generations that follow.


Visit group.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.


**About the Brand**

Springer Nature Technology and Publishing Solutions is the technology and publishing solutions arm of the Springer Nature Group. We leverage our insight in the publishing domain and acquire, produce and deliver content across media and markets using our Technology and Publishing Solutions. With a focus on technology driven solutions and deep insight in the publishing domain, Springer Nature Technology and Publishing Solutions offers a range of services that help our Group brand acquire, produce and deliver content in the most efficient ways possible. We are driven by over 1000 professionals in Technology, Research \& Analysis and Marketing shared services.


**About the Role**

The **Senior Workday Core HCM Specialist** will be the lead subject matter expert for Workday Core HCM with a primary focus on **process optimization, data quality and validation, and automated document generation** . This role will own existing end\-to\-end Workday HCM processes, design and enforce data validation frameworks, drive continuous process improvements, and deliver high\-quality operational documentation and generated outputs (offer letters, contracts, reports). The specialist will partner closely with HR, Payroll, IT, vendors and downstream system owners to ensure Workday is configured and operated to deliver accurate, auditable, and scalable HR services.


**Responsibilities** :


* **Workday Core HCM Ownership** — Lead design, configuration and maintenance of Core HR (Employee Lifecycle) business processes to enhance data accuracy and useability
* **Process Optimization** — Map current\-state processes, identify inefficiencies, design streamlined Workday\-driven processes, and implement automation (including document generation) to reduce manual work and error rates.
* **Data Quality and Validation** — Define and implement data governance rules, validation checks, reconciliation routines and exception handling across Workday and downstream systems.
* **Document Generation and Templates** — Design, build and maintain document generation templates and automated outputs (e.g., offer letters, employment contracts, HR reports) ensuring consistency, compliance and localization where required.
* **Reporting and Analytics** — Create advanced Workday reports and dashboards that surface data quality metrics, process KPIs and audit trails; use calculated fields and transformations to support validation logic.
* **Testing and Release Management** — Lead end\-to\-end testing for configuration changes, business process updates and Workday releases; manage change control and rollback plans.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration** — Act as the primary liaison between HR functional sponsors, IT, vendors and external partners to translate business requirements into robust system specifications.
* **Operational Excellence** — Maintain runbooks, SOPs and documentation for processes, validations and generated documents; coach and upskill HR operations teams on best practices.
* **Continuous Improvement** — Monitor Workday release notes, evaluate new features for process enablement, and drive adoption of enhancements that improve data integrity and automation.

**Experience, Skills \& Qualifications** :


* **Proven Workday expertise** : Extensive hands\-on experience with Workday Core HCM configuration, business process framework, complex calculated fields, and report writing.
* **Data governance experience** : Demonstrable track record implementing data validation frameworks, reconciliation processes and data remediation programs.
* **Document generation skills** : Experience building and maintaining automated document templates and generation processes within Workday or integrated document engines.
* **Technical fluency** : Strong understanding of Workday business object model, integrations concepts, and ability to collaborate with integration engineers and vendors.
* **Analytical and testing capability** : Advanced analytical skills with experience designing test plans, UAT, regression testing and documenting results.
* **Communication and leadership** : Excellent stakeholder management, presentation and written communication skills; ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives and mentor junior colleagues.
* **Education and experience** : Bachelor’s degree in HR, IT, Computer Science or related field preferred; 5\+ years Workday Core HCM experience with progressive responsibility.

**Behaviours and Values**

* **Customer focused** — prioritizes HR and employee experience while balancing technical constraints.
* **Detail oriented** — rigorous about data accuracy, auditability and compliance.
* **Proactive problem solver** — anticipates issues and drives pragmatic solutions.

Job Purpose Description

#### **Job Context \& Major Challenges**


Alupuram Works produces and sells over 12000 TPA of Aluminium extrusions.
  

  

The entire company property includes, two Extrusion presses with it its down stream processing equipments, Casting plant with furnaces and other facilities, other support services, three residential colonies which have 180 quarters and 2 Bungalows and two Guest Houses with total land area of around 128 acres. This factory located in a semi\-urban area and value of the land and other assets comes around Rs.600 Crores. There is potential for theft and encroachment of land in case of any security lapse.  

  

  

  

  

  

  

In Kerala the labour laws are very stringent and company should ensure to provide all welfare facilities to its employees. Presently there are 430 permanent employees and 85 Contractors¿ workmen working inside the factory. Liaise with Labour department and other Governmental departments are very essential to be in good relations. Employee relations in an environment of strong trade unionism with political back up need more attention.  

  

Company initiates CSR activities in the villages surrounding the plant, which have a population of 35000, and total area will be 12 sq. kilometers. Major CSR activities include support to Education, Woman empowerment for Sustainable development and Infrastructure facilities and Health care programmes. Liaise with Local bodies and NGOs are essential for mobilizing funds from various Govt. schemes and implementing these activities effectively.  

  

To gather and convey important and confidential information to top management and convey communications to employees and their unions and stakeholders are very essential to foster harmonious and effective relationship. Trade unions are very aggressive and liaise with unions need special attention to facilitate the negotiation and implementation of any expansion project proposals.  

  

  

  

  

Contractors¿ workmen carry out company insourced and outsourced jobs. A good number of them are migrant laborers from different parts of the country and the background of those workmen is unknown. In the context of terrorist attacks at various places, more vigilance is required and hence the whereabouts of these workmen are checked to prevent any untoward incidents.  

  

  

  

  

There are two Guesthouses comprising 8 rooms. V VIPs like MD visits the plant and hence facilitating the stay with hospitality are highly desirable. The GH rooms are fully booked round the year.

Monitor and regulate the engagement of Contractors¿ Workmen to carried out the outsourced and insourced jobs

Coordinate Hindalco Community center activities and under budgeted cost.

Job description
  
  

**Job Description:**  

Join our team and start a new adventure in an international and dynamic environment, where you will be able to fulfil your career expectations in a fast\-growing organization. Being a consultant at Amaris Consulting means positioning yourself as a technical and functional expert in an industrial field, but above all, being an ambassador of our organization to clients, thanks to:
  
  

Your interpersonal skills and ability to listen, in order to build a strong relationship of trust with our clients and fully understand their challenges and issues.
  
Your curiosity and eagerness to learn, as we support over 1,000 clients from all sectors worldwide.
  
  

Your missions
  
  

Implement and configure Workday Compensation and Advanced Compensation modules for clients
  
Analyze business requirements and translate them into Workday solutions
  
Customize compensation plans, merit cycles, bonus plans, and related business processes
  
Conduct system testing, troubleshooting, and resolve issues
  
Deliver end\-user training and create documentation for clients
  
Support data migration and integration activities related to compensation
  
Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery
  
Provide post\-go\-live support and continuous improvements
  
  

Your profile
  
  

Experience in Workday Compensation and Advanced Compensation module implementation or support
  
Experience with HRIS systems and business process configuration
  
Experience with generative AI tools
  
Workday Compensation or Advanced Compensation certification is a plus
  
**Academic background:** information technology, human resources, or related field
  
English fluent.
  
You demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
  
You demonstrate strong communication skills
  
You demonstrate strong organizational skills
  
  

Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.
  
  

Who are we?
  
Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System \& Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.
  
  

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:
  
  

**Brief Call:** Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!
  
  

Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 \- the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!
  
  

**Case study:** Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem\-solving scenario, etc.
  
  

As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.
  
We look forward to meeting you!

description:
### **About Us**


Every day at AMS, we connect talent and opportunity, helping people, businesses and communities grow.



Our strength lies in partnership \- we listen, collaborate and learn from one another.



Whether you’re helping a client redefine their talent strategy or finding new ways to grow your own career, your work helps millions of people find their dream jobs every year. Your talent is our greatest asset, and we're dedicated to providing avenues for you to reach its fullest potential. We do so by providing the environment, resources, networks, and career experiences essential for your progress



Take the next step in your career journey and discover our exciting opportunities.

### **The Role**


We recognize that great talent isn’t defined by titles but by skills and mindset.



At AMS, we’re looking for people who bring more than experience \- they bring capability, curiosity, and the drive to contribute and grow with the team. As a Recruiter Specialist for the RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing) team, you will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end recruitment activities for our BFSI client. You will work closely with hiring managers and stakeholders to understand their staffing needs and identify qualified candidates through various sourcing methods. You will be responsible for screening, interviewing, and assessing candidates, offer negotiation as well as managing the entire recruitment process from sourcing to onboarding. Your expertise in the BFSI industry and knowledge of talent acquisition best practices will be crucial in identifying top talent for our client's organization.



If you’re skilled, who have managed audit, risk and compliance hiring and excited to progress your career, this role could be your next step.

### **Key Accountabilities**

What you’ll do:


* Collaborate with hiring managers and stakeholders to understand their recruitment needs and develop a comprehensive recruitment strategy for roles.
* Utilize various sourcing methods, including job boards, social media, networking, and referrals, to identify and attract qualified candidates.
* Conduct thorough screening, interviewing, and assessment of candidates to evaluate their skills, experience, and cultural fit with the organization.
* Manage the entire recruitment process, including scheduling interviews, conducting background checks, negotiating job offers, and facilitating onboarding for selected candidates.
* Build and maintain a talent pipeline for BFSI roles, ensuring a steady pool of qualified candidates for current and future hiring needs.
* Stay updated with industry trends, market insights, and competitive intelligence related to BFSI talent acquisition, and provide recommendations to optimize recruitment strategies.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS) and other recruitment tools to ensure data integrity and compliance with data protection regulations.
* Provide regular reports and metrics on recruitment activities, including time\-to\-fill, source of hire, and quality of candidates, to stakeholders and management.

### **Skills \& Requirements**

**What background we desire:**

  


* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 8 \+ years of experience as a recruiter, preferably in the BFSI industry.
* In\-depth knowledge of talent acquisition best practices, including sourcing, interviewing, and assessment techniques.
* Strong understanding of the BFSI industry, including roles, skills, and market trends.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast\-paced environment, while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.
* Proficiency in using applicant tracking systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with a team.
* Professional certifications in HR or talent acquisition (e.g., PHR, SHRM\-CP, AIRS, etc.) are a plus.

### **Why AMS?**


We all play a role in our success \- whether that’s working directly with clients or adding value behind the scenes. By working together, we bring stronger insight to our clients and create more diverse and rewarding career journeys for our people.



Beyond our standard benefits package, you’ll have the flexibility, autonomy, and trust to work in a way that fits you. Our focus is on enabling meaningful collaboration and support, so you can do your best work \- your way.


**We offer**


* Growth and development focused on your strengths
* The opportunity to develop a career within one of the world’s leading organisations specialising in talent and workforce solutions.
* A team that values being Passionate, Bold, and Authentic
* Supportive communities such as our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
* Volunteer day \- you get one additional paid day off each year to volunteer for a cause that matters to you

* Flexibility in how and where you work\*

We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage people with diverse skills, perspectives, and experiences to apply. description:
About Mednevo

Mednevo is an early\-stage AI healthcare startup revolutionizing \*primary healthcare\* in India. We combine \*cutting\-edge AI technology\* with a genuine patient\-first approach to deliver accessible, personalized, and high\-quality care. Our platform integrates \*on\-demand virtual consultations, in\-home doctor visits, proactive wellness monitoring, and AI\-powered tools for interactive consultations, patient education, and personalized health insights.

We are particularly focused on making quality care — including pediatric care — more efficient, affordable, and scalable across urban and semi\-urban India. As a small, high\-impact team (2\-10 people), we move fast and solve real problems: reducing wait times, supporting clinical decisions with AI, improving outcomes for families and children, and building the future of intelligent healthcare delivery.

The Opportunity We are looking for a passionate Medical Doctor to join as a Co\-Founder. This is not a traditional clinical job — it is a founding leadership role where you will shape the clinical vision, build the product alongside AI engineers, and help scale a mission\-driven healthcare ecosystem. You will bring real\-world medical expertise (especially in pediatrics) to ensure our AI tools are clinically accurate, safe, empathetic, and truly useful for Indian families and doctors.

Key Responsibilities **⁠ ⁠**

**Clinical Leadership \& Product Vision: Co\-define the medical strategy and clinical pathways, with special focus on pediatric care, primary health, preventive wellness, and common childhood conditions.** ⁠ ⁠AI \+ Medicine Integration: Work closely with AI engineers to train, validate, and refine AI models for symptom assessment, triage, personalized advice, and decision support. **Patient Care Excellence: Lead or supervise virtual consultations and in\-home visits (initially hands\-on, later more strategic). Help design workflows that blend human empathy with AI efficiency.** ⁠ ⁠Product Development: Collaborate on building user\-friendly tools for doctors, patients, and parents — including pediatric growth tracking, vaccination reminders, developmental screening, and family health management. **⁠ ⁠**

**Regulatory \& Quality: Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, data privacy (HIPAA\-like standards), and medical ethics in India.** ⁠ ⁠Growth \& Ecosystem Building: Support fundraising, partnerships with hospitals/clinics, go\-to\-market strategy, and expansion of our AI\-hospital ecosystem. Represent Mednevo at medical conferences and among the doctor community.

**⁠ ⁠Team \& Culture: Help build a high\-trust, innovative team culture that attracts top medical and tech talent. What We’re Looking For** ⁠ ⁠Medical Qualification: MBBS from a recognized institution (mandatory). MD/DNB Pediatrics (pursuing or completed) is a strong advantage. **⁠ ⁠**

**Experience: 0\-2 years post\-MBBS (including internships or residency). Fresh graduates or final\-year MD candidates with strong academic records and genuine interest in technology are encouraged to apply.** ⁠ ⁠Passion for AI \& Innovation: Curiosity or experience in digital health, telemedicine, or AI applications in medicine. **⁠Pediatric Interest: Strong preference for candidates with exposure to or deep interest in pediatrics — child health, neonatology, developmental pediatrics, or family medicine.** ⁠ ⁠Founder Mindset: Entrepreneurial spirit, ownership attitude, resilience, and excitement about building something from the ground up. Ability to wear multiple hats in a fast\-paced startup. **⁠ ⁠Skills: Excellent communication (especially with patients/parents), empathy, basic tech\-savviness, and comfort working in a remote/hybrid setup.** ⁠ ⁠Location: Open to candidates in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, or willing to relocate/base in Chennai/Thiruvananthapuram. **Learning \& Impact: Direct mentorship from the Founder \& CEO. Opportunity to shape AI tools that can impact thousands of patients, especially children and families.** ⁠ ⁠Flexible Work: Remote\-first with support for in\-person clinical or team activities. **⁠ ⁠**

**Growth: Be part of a mission\-driven team at the intersection of AI, pediatrics, and healthcare innovation in one of India’s fastest\-growing sectors. **Roles and Responsibilities:** 1\. Protect CRBG: To fulfill the first objective, the role holder will have a strong grasp of the CRBG Sox and Soc controls that Accenture Delivery executes for CRBG as well as the CRBG risk escalation and reporting policy a) Understand the CRBG control environment and operations context and promote compliance with the CRBG Risk Escalation policy within that context b) Understand the Accenture Operations Delivery role in the CRBG business from the detailed level of the DTPs to the SOWs and MSA where applicable c) Communicate risk incidents and events in an articulate and professional risk lens manner, categorizing by risk type (operational, fraud, privacy) d) Drive risk remediation and issues management efforts to de\-risk the CRBG control environment through proposed control enhancements e) Facilitate / host / contribute to risk governance meetings including weekly client risk meetings f) Support and drive data integrity including Accenture\-CRBG risk inventories to ensure completion of all risk events g) Prep and support client risk governance meetings as well as internal Accenture prep meetings with Leadership to ensure alignment on messaging h) Oversee, evaluate, and test the CRBG Sox / Soc Control Execution and Attestation process i) Partner with first line Accenture teams on first line control testing and contribute to risk remediation efforts to improve preventative controls to reduce residual risk j) Partner with CRBG risk teams on risk initiatives and projects k) Produce risk insights reporting to showcase the risk trends, thresholds, and metrics based on agreed CRBG \+ Accenture’s risk appetite 2\. Protect Accenture To fulfill the second objective, the role holder will understand the operational and financial impacts of operational and fraud losses to Accenture a) Follow Accenture policies and promote compliance with these policies when considering risk events within the CRBG environment (e.g. ensure ASOCs are raised by Delivery when needed) b) Understand the MSA and SOW for the CRBG account including provisions and change orders that refer to financial impacts such as Payment Loss and Breakage (gain loss) c) Quantify Financial Impacts to Accenture based on contractual baseline methodology by reviewing risk events for process date, reported date, DTP expectation at process date, justification for assignment of fault (CRBG or Accenture) QA / QC effectiveness, root cause, risk mitigation and remediation plans

title: Director, Data Strategy & Engineering (India Team)
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago headquartered, middle market focused advisory, interim management and investment banking firm with a national footprint across ten US offices. It delivers deeply integrated, cross functional solutions across Transaction Advisory, Valuations, Investment Banking, Turnaround \& Restructuring, Performance Improvement, Transaction Execution Services and Office of the CFO services. Backed by 160\+ experts with blue\-chip consulting, finance, operations and investing backgrounds, the firm brings a uniquely holistic perspective to complex financial and operational situations.

The firm is known for its high impact, high pace execution model and has grown rapidly since inception in 2016\.

The Director, Data Strategy \& Engineering role at Portage Point represents a unique opportunity to define and execute the firm’s data platform vision for the India delivery organization. This Director will own the strategic direction of all data assets, architecture, governance and capability building that underpin the firm’s AI product portfolio and consulting analytics services, spanning high\-value use cases including commercial and financial due diligence (CDD/FDD), value creation tracking, working capital optimization, restructuring scenario analysis, portfolio company performance benchmarking and management information system (MIS) intelligence layers. Reporting to the India Delivery Leader as a peer to the Director, AI Solutions, and partnering closely with US\-based Practice Line Leaders, this Director will lead a team of two to three Vice Presidents and their Senior Associates (approximately 15 to 20 professionals) across data engineering, analytics engineering and data governance, owning hiring, vendor partner management and capability development across the function. This person will operate as a true data executive within the India capability centre — influencing how data is collected, structured, governed and commercialized across the firm’s global consulting practice, and representing the firm externally as a subject matter expert on data strategy in deal advisory and portfolio management. If you are a senior data leader with deep technical depth and a consulting or professional services background who wants to define how data and AI transform a high\-growth advisory firm, this is the right role for you.



### **Responsibilities**

* Define and own the firm’s data platform strategy for the India delivery organization, spanning cloud data architecture, AI data infrastructure, master data management and the analytics capability roadmap
* Drive architectural decisions for the firm’s data ecosystem including data lakehouse design (bronze/silver/gold medallion architecture), real\-time versus batch processing trade\-offs, semantic layer strategy, data mesh adoption and AI\-ready data product frameworks
* Own the data architecture review function, ensuring all new AI products and data pipelines meet architectural, security and governance standards before development commences
* Execute the data strategy that enables the AI Solutions product roadmap, defining how data is structured, labeled, versioned and served to AI/ML models across consulting use cases including CDD/FDD automation, value creation tracking, working capital optimization, restructuring scenario engines, portfolio benchmarking and MIS intelligence layers
* Drive the development of the firm’s proprietary financial and industry data assets including training data curation, golden datasets for model evaluation and benchmarking databases
* Design the firm’s knowledge graph strategy, capturing structured relationships between companies, deal comparables, management teams and operational KPIs to power next\-generation AI reasoning
* Oversee design and operation of scalable ELT/ETL pipelines ingesting structured and unstructured data from diverse sources including financial data providers (Capital IQ, Refinitiv, PitchBook, Bloomberg), client ERP/CRM systems, SEC filings, management packs and market research
* Own the analytics engineering layer powering consulting analytics including financial benchmarking, working capital KPI dashboards, EBITDA bridge models and cost structure analyses, and build reusable data product templates that let consulting teams rapidly spin up client\-specific analytics environments
* Lead and develop a team of two to three Vice Presidents and their Senior Associates (approximately 15 to 20 professionals) across data engineering, analytics engineering and data governance, providing strategic and technical direction, conducting structured performance reviews and owning career development
* Drive talent strategy for the Data Strategy \& Engineering function including hiring plans, role design, vendor partner selection and management, capability building, career ladders and compensation benchmarking in partnership with HR
* Drive the data governance framework including policies, standards, stewardship model and compliance controls for handling client deal data, portfolio company data and third\-party data, in alignment with NDA and regulatory obligations
* Oversee data security architecture in collaboration with the security function, with particular attention to AI training data handling, model output retention and deal data segregation
* Build and operate data quality programs including automated monitoring, anomaly detection and alerting to surface data issues before they affect AI model outputs or consulting deliverables
* Partner with the India Delivery Leader, the Director, AI Solutions and US\-based Practice Line Leaders to translate firm priorities into a sequenced data platform roadmap with measurable business outcomes, and report on platform\-level KPIs including adoption, data quality, freshness SLAs, productivity impact and ROI
* Identify and shape data monetization opportunities within the firm’s consulting practice including proprietary benchmarking databases, index products and data\-as\-a\-service offerings, and partner with firm leadership to commercialize proprietary data assets as consulting IP and competitive differentiators
* Serve as a thought leader on data strategy in deal advisory and portfolio management, engaging in senior client conversations on data room analytics, portfolio data standardization and data\-driven value creation, and representing the firm at internal forums and external industry events where appropriate
* Manage relationships with third\-party data providers, evaluate new data sources for relevance to consulting use cases and lead the evaluation and adoption of emerging data technologies including data mesh, federated query engines and AI\-native data platforms
* Contribute selectively as a hands\-on technical leader on flagship initiatives where senior architectural judgment is required
* Lead firm\-wide knowledge sharing, training and change management efforts to scale data and analytics capability across practice lines
* Support business development by shaping data\-related proposals, client presentations and solution demonstrations
* Support internal trainings and best practice sharing
* Contribute to a high\-performing, inclusive and values\-driven culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s of Technology / Engineering and / or Master's in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics or related technical field from a top undergraduate program; MBA with quantitative focus strongly preferred
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* Ability to collaborate across global time zones, including US\-based teams
* Ten to fifteen years of progressive experience in AI/ML, software engineering or related technical disciplines, with a meaningful portion of that experience in management consulting, professional services or private equity\-backed advisory environments
* Demonstrated experience leading AI or technology functions of 10 or more professionals, including managing managers and developing senior individual contributors
* Proven track record setting product or portfolio roadmaps for AI, data or software functions and translating ambiguous business priorities into sequenced delivery plans
* Track record building and scaling teams, including direct hiring leadership and experience managing vendor or offshore delivery partners
* Deep working knowledge of LLM\-powered applications, agentic AI architectures, automation workflows and the modern AI tooling ecosystem (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, LangChain, N8N, Zapier or similar)
* Proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and the ability to engage credibly in technical reviews and architectural decisions
* Strong understanding of data engineering, model evaluation, MLOps and modern software development practices
* Demonstrated ability to establish and enforce responsible AI standards including bias detection, explainability and data privacy across production AI systems
* Experience operating in client\-facing or executive\-facing settings with the ability to shape AI\-related proposals, presentations and senior stakeholder conversations
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive\-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast\-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high\-pressure environments
* Ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders

title: Manager, Regulatory Affairs
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company’s patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**Brief team/department description:**



As a part of the Regulatory Affairs team at Azurity, the Regulatory Affairs Manager will be responsible for overseeing and managing the regulatory activities for assigned products/projects and will serve as the regulatory representative on cross\-functional teams for assigned projects. Key accountabilities include providing regulatory guidance, requirements and strategy for assigned projects, ensuring compliance with regulations, company standards and commitments. The regulatory team works across multiple complex projects, facilitating various types of submissions to agencies like the FDA, HC, EMA, MHRA and other international authorities, by ensuring compliance with evolving regulations.


**Principle Responsibilities:**


* Represent Regulatory Affairs on assigned product and related project team (both internal and external cross\-functional teams)
* Provide regulatory assessment of due diligence requests to support new business development activities.
* Serve as primary interface with FDA and other health authorities and regulatory agencies for assigned products.
* Drive regulatory strategies for drug product registration and life\-cycle management across global markets, with primary responsibility of managing submissions within North America.
* Manage regulatory filings including IND, NDA, ANDA and NDS for a variety of dosage forms including solid oral, parenteral, liquids, inhalation and nasal, and drug/device combination drug products
* Manage operational aspects of preparing compliant submissions to regulatory agencies.
* Establish and manage timelines associated with regulatory submissions.
* Manage archive of regulatory submissions, regulatory correspondence and associated logs and tracking mechanisms as per SOPs.
* Provide regulatory guidance on requirements for post\-approval changes, as required, for assigned commercial products including change control assessments.
* Establish regulatory strategy for assigned projects with input from project teams.
* Provide regulatory support for Senior Leadership Team (SLT) and Executive Leadership Team (ELT) meetings and presentations.
* Monitor evolving, region\-specific regulations and proactively provide strategic guidance to cross\-functional teams to ensure compliance.
* Assist in preparing budgets and reviewing invoices on assigned projects and relevant product/filing fees, as needed.
* Participate in various activities of setting goals, tracking deliverables and process improvements within the regulatory department.


**Qualifications and Education Requirements**


* Minimum Bachelor of Science or preferred advanced health care discipline degree (PharmD, PhD, Master of Science, etc.) or equivalent qualification.
* Minimum of 8\-10 years in the pharmaceutical industry with at least 8 of those years in regulatory affairs.
* Combination of education and applicable job experience may be considered.
* Excellent organizational, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, strong grammar, and proofreading/editing skills, and MS Office skills are required.
* Track record of successfully working with cross\-functional teams, including external partners
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast\-paced deadline driven environment.
* Keen attention to detail.
* Ability to successfully communicate, negotiate and influence regulatory strategy to key stakeholders.
* Ability to rapidly adapt to changing environment and circumstances requiring flexibility, tolerance and great sense of urgency while ensuring that all cGMP and regulatory requirements are met.
* Ability to successfully communicate, negotiate and influence regulatory strategy to key stakeholders.

* Manage the IP portfolio, including patents and trademarks, across multiple jurisdictions.

2**. IP Due Diligence \& Risk Management**


* Perform prior art searches, patentability assessments, landscape analysis, and freedom\-to\-operate (FTO)evaluations.
* Analyze Orange Book\-listed patents \& Pending Patent Applications and develop IP strategies in compliance with regulatory and legal requirements.
* Generate risk assessment reports \& provide IP clearances for proposed formulations, synthesis routes, polymorphs, and manufacturing processes.
* Analyze the IP to develop non\-infringement and patent invalidation strategies, including prior art search and claim construction.
* Provide scientific and technical input to attorneys while responding to office actions.


 3\. **Litigation** **\& Regulatory Support**


* Provide strategic support to the Legal team on patent litigations, including IPR (Inter Partes Review) and PGR (Post\-Grant Review) proceedings.
* Develop claim construction and invalidity arguments, leveraging prior art and technical literature.
* Monitor ongoing litigations, especially within the U.S., and assess potential business impact.


 4**.Cross\-functional Collaboration**


* Collaborate with the R\&D team to identify patentable inventions and formulate patentable strategies.
* Partner with the R\&D team to identify opportunities for differentiated product filings, including 505(b)(2\) and ANDA strategies.
* Engage with relevant stakeholders (R\&D, Regulatory, Clinical \& Legal teams) to define acceptable IP goals.
* Support the development of alternate or workaround strategies for blocking IP.
* Conduct literature reviews (patent and non\-patent) to support R\&D and IP analysis.


5**.Market \& Competitive Intelligence**


* Continuously monitor market trends, IP filings, and competitive developments through SEC filings, earnings calls, and public disclosures.
* Conduct whitespace analysis and technology mapping to identify new opportunities.

* Advanced degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Chemistry, or related scientific discipline.
* 10–12 years of relevant experience in Intellectual Property domain within the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry, preferably with a focus on formulations.


**Preferred Skills \& Attributes**


* Deep understanding of global patent systems and procedures (including Indian, US, EP, and PCT).
* Demonstrated expertise in patent analysis, drafting, prosecution, and litigation support.
* Exposure to P\-IV litigations is highly desirable.
* Expertise in global IP law, with hands\-on experience in patent filing, prosecution, and infringement/invalidity analysis.
* Strong command over FTO analysis, Orange Book navigation, and regulatory IP alignment (including 505(b)(2\) applications).
* Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills with an ability to work effectively in cross\-functional and global teams.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive mindset.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for effective cross\-functional collaboration.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and negotiate within multidisciplinary teams.
* Comfort working across multiple time zones and adapting to a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

description:
**About Aptia**

Founded to shape the future of pensions, health, and insurance solutions, Aptia is a leading professional services firm dedicated to simplifying complexity for businesses and individuals. We bring together cutting\-edge technology and deep industry expertise to help organisations navigate an evolving landscape with clarity and confidence.


With a presence in the US, UK, India, and Portugal, we support over six million people and more than 1,100 clients, delivering solutions that drive efficiency, enhance financial security, and provide peace of mind.


Our strength lies in the combination of smart technology and expert teams, ensuring that managing pensions, health, and insurance is more effective. By focusing on innovation, accessibility, and client success, we help businesses take care of their people, so they can focus on what they do best.


And we are expanding. Aptia Group is not only fueled by our investors' backing but also by our commitment to foster the growth and success of our people. At Aptia, we're investing heavily in learning and development, paving unique career paths for our colleagues.


Specialist. Responsive. Thoughtful. Our values aren't just words; they are the backbone of our business. Our team embodies our values daily, to surpass client expectations, evolve constantly and nurture genuine relationships for the long\-term.


**Job requirements**

**Job Title:** Pensions Administration Domain Trainer
  

**Location:** India (Hybrid / On\-site)
  

**Experience:** 3–6 Years
  

**Department:** Learning \& Talent
  

**Reporting to:** Lead – Pensions Training Academy


**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Pensions Domain Trainer to independently deliver high\-quality training for our UK pensions administration team. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in pensions operations, strong facilitation skills, and the ability to simplify technical topics for new joiners and colleagues who want to upskill or go for a relevant certification.


While initial onboarding and guidance will be provided, the candidate is expected to independently manage the end\-to\-end training lifecycle—including facilitation, learner engagement, Q\&A sessions, and training administration—within a few weeks of joining.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Training Delivery**

* Deliver structured training programs on UK pensions administration processes for new joiners and upskilling programs for existing employees.
* Facilitate virtual and/or classroom sessions covering pensions operations (joiners, leavers, retirements, transfers, etc.) with clarity and impact.
* Conduct Q\&A sessions and reinforcement sessions using practical examples from real cases.
* Stay updated on UK pension regulations and changes and reflect them in learning sessions where applicable.

**Training Administration \& Coordination**

* Manage training logistics including session scheduling, attendance tracking, learner assessments, and certification preparation coordination.
* Collaborate with senior trainers and content developers to enhance training materials based on delivery experience.
* Report training delivery status, learner progress, assessment scores, and key observations to the relevant stakeholders; flag any risks or support needed proactively.
* Collect feedback and share suggestions for improvement with the L\&D team.
* Maintain training documentation, FAQs, and session\-wise trackers.

**Content Development \& SME Support**

* Provide **subject matter expertise (SME)** to instructional designers and learning developers for the creation of high\-quality **e\-learning modules and other digital assets** for the Pensions domain learning.
* Review the learning content to ensure technical accuracy, relevance, completeness, and alignment with latest UK pensions regulations.
* Offer insights and updates to support the continuous improvement of the learning material.

**Must\-have Training Skills**

To be successful in this role, the following facilitation competencies are essential:


* **Clarity of Communication** : Ability to explain technical and regulatory concepts in simple, understandable language.
* **Voice Modulation \& Pacing** : Effective verbal delivery with variation in tone, pitch, and pace to maintain interest.
* **Command over English Language** : Clear articulation, correct grammar usage, and professional vocabulary to ensure credibility and learner comprehension across UK\-based processes.
* **Learner Engagement** : Use of questioning techniques, examples, scenarios, and digital tools to keep sessions interactive.
* **Confidence \& Preparation** : Thorough command over session content, with readiness to address learner questions independently.
* **Responsiveness \& Patience** : Addressing queries professionally while encouraging participation across knowledge levels.
* **Continuous Improvement Mindset:** Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, seeking better ways to enhance learning and delivery.

**Required Skills and Experience**

**Must\-Have**

* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience in UK pensions administration or a closely related process.
* Comfort with virtual platforms (Teams/Zoom) and basic presentation tools (PPT, whiteboard tools).
* Strong organizational skills for managing batch\-wise logistics, learner data, and follow\-ups.
* High accountability for independent training delivery after initial support phase.
* Pensions Administration domain experience is a must.

**Good\-to\-Have**

* Exposure to CPC or APE content or certification (preferred but not mandatory).
* Experience coordinating or contributing to training content development.
* Familiarity with LMS tools or digital learning platforms.

**Who can apply?**

This role is not limited to colleagues who are already working in training or learning teams within pensions or benefits administration organisations.


We are equally open to experienced pensions administrators who are currently working in the business or operations side and are interested in pivoting into a training role and building a career in learning. What is non\-negotiable is **deep expertise in pensions administration, a strong understanding of the regulatory environment, pensions rules, and the ability to work through and explain complex calculation scenarios and cases** .


Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear, simple way are essential. Prior, in\-depth training experience is not a requirement.


In this role, you will combine your pensions expertise with the support of a learning and talent team that brings deep experience in designing high\-quality learning solutions, using modern learning methodologies, digital formats, and learning technology.


Aptia is doing exciting work in building skills and capability across the organisation, and this role offers the opportunity to be part of that journey while developing a new dimension of your career.


**How to apply**

If you are interested in this role, then we’d love to hear from you. Please go ahead and click apply and submit your resume with appropriate contact information.


Aptia is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable work environment. At Aptia, fostering an equitable and inclusive environment for all our people to flourish is a priority. We are an equal opportunity employer and aim to attract and retain the best people without attention to age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, political affiliation, race, religion, gender and sexual orientation.  



  

If there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process to ensure it is accessible to you, we encourage you to reach out to us.

**Job Summary:**
----------------


In this role, you will support contingent workforce operations by managing work orders, payroll\-related processes, and vendor coordination activities. You will be responsible for ensuring data accuracy, compliance, and timely processing across systems while partnering cross\-functionally with internal teams and external suppliers. This position requires strong problem\-solving skills, the ability to manage high\-volume work in a fast\-paced environment, and a proactive approach to research and process improvement.
This position is designated as part\-time telework per our global telework policy and may require at least three days of in\-person attendance per week at the assigned office or project. Weekly in\-person schedules will be determined by the individual and their supervisor, in consultation with functional or project leadership.**Major Responsibilities:**
---------------------------

**Create \& Manage Job Postings:** Develop job posting templates, assist hiring managers, and ensure alignment with job classifications and job keys.  

**Work Order Processing:** Create, review, and revise work orders for data accuracy, pay rates, assignment updates, and compliance with staffing agreements.  

**Onboarding \& Reporting:** Manage first\-day reporting instructions, badging paperwork, and provide required information to staffing agencies and projects.  

**Personnel Monitoring \& Compliance:** Track personnel assignments, ensure timely processing of assignment extensions and policy compliance.  

**Agency Conversions \& Release Notifications:** Coordinate conversions of agency staff to Bechtel and handle release notifications and work order deactivations.  

**Fieldglass System \& Vendor Management:** Use Fieldglass software to troubleshoot issues, support system processes, and recommend improvements.  

**Data Collection \& Reporting:** Collect, analyze, and assemble data for personnel reports, payroll processing, timekeeping, and expense management.  

**Payroll \& Financial Support:** Support payroll\-related activities, validate financial data, and ensure alignment with finance processes and controls.  

**Account Reconciliation:** Perform reconciliation of records across systems to ensure accuracy of payroll, invoicing, and financial data.  

**Audit \& Compliance:** Support audit activities by ensuring documentation accuracy, compliance with policies, and readiness for internal/external reviews.  

**Vendor Relations \& Supplier Onboarding:** Build relationships with vendors, assist with onboarding, contract coordination, and system setup for suppliers.  

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and project teams to resolve issues and ensure seamless operations.  

**Training \& Continuous Improvement:** Train team members on PMO standards, document processes, and support continuous improvement initiatives.  

**Research \& Problem Solving:** Conduct research to resolve issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions in a non\-repetitive, dynamic environment.

**Education and Experience Requirements:**
------------------------------------------


Bachelor's degree in HR, Finance, Accounting, or related field. In lieu of degree, position requires minimum two (2\) years work experience in an administrative or HR processing role and two (2\) to eight (8\) years' experience in payroll processing, finance, or related field.
Experience and familiarity with payroll processing in SAP, Oracle, Fieldglass, or other ERP systems.

* Strong background in **payroll and finance processes**, including data validation and reconciliation
* Experience supporting **audit activities** and maintaining compliance with policies and procedures
* Strong **technical aptitude** with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Fieldglass

optimize critical processes. Our mission is to create a lasting impact by equipping organizations with the strategy, skills, and tools needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving world.


**Role Purpose**
----------------

The HR Generalist plays a critical role in delivering efficient and compliant HR Operations support across key functional areas, including payroll, statutory compliance, employee life cycle management, and employee services.


**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

**HR Operations \& Payroll Support**

* Provide day\-to\-day HR Operations support covering payroll administration, compensation inputs, onboarding, employee relations support, and employee exit processes.
* Liaise with payroll service providers to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing in line with defined calendars and compliance requirements.

**Time Office \& Attendance Management**
